scientific_integrity: All claimed inequalities derive from exact Schur complements and Jacobi minor identities; the accompanying independent-arithmetic test script checks finite instances without being treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight stars and a uniform positive shift; exact unrescaled Nyström only. Does not cover general trees, varying spokes, noisy selected columns or other matrix norms. Accessible literature may not exhaust historical priority, and the complete text of the closest indexed unshifted-star theorem could not be inspected.
title: Sharp hub-abandonment staircase for screened-star Nyström landmarks
